name: Short Cut Mediterranean Chopped Salad with Chickpeas, Roasted Red Peppers & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Place the contents of each salad kit in a medium bowl (reserving dressing and topping packets).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (312 g) pkg Mediterranean crunch chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the bowl with the salad.
Drain and slice peppers into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl along with the dressing. Toss to combine the salad, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (340 g) jar roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with feta and flatbread strips. Enjoy!
